Ana G: Heads-up  Vendor Z issued a $12,500 credit on INV-2024-0620 (annual prepaid 2024-05-01 to 2025-04-30). Unsure whether to reduce deferred revenue or book as contra-rev. Close Friday, need guidance.
Mike R: Share invoice id + vendor note. Also how much of the service period has already been recognized?
Ana G: INV-2024-0620, original $125,000, credit $12,500 (10%). Recognized through 2024-10 = 6 months recognized (6/12).
Sophia L: Language from vendor? If "credit for overcharge" -> prior-period correction. If "promotional adjustment" -> prospective.
Ana G: Vendor note: "billing reconciliation credit for overcharge on INV-2024-0620".
Ben (FP&A): Impact quick calc: original monthly = 10,416.67. New total = 112,500 -> new monthly = 9,375. Recognized portion of the credit = 6 months * (10,416.67) * 10% = 6,250 recognized; remaining 6,250 is deferred.
Mike R: Controller required. If prior-period, need restatement memo + CFO sign-off. Draft corrective JE if approved to reverse recognized revenue portion:
```
DR 4000 Revenue - Subscription 6,250
CR 2100 Accounts Payable/Cash 6,250  (or contra-rev depending on policy)
```
And adjust deferred revenue for remaining 6,250:
```
DR 2400 Deferred Revenue 6,250
CR 4000 Revenue - Subscription 6,250
```
Maria Controller: Agree with assessment. Treat as prior-period error given vendor wording. Prepare restatement memo and impact schedule. Do not post corrective JEs until CFO + audit alignment.
Mike R: To avoid blocking close, move full credit to a suspense account pending approvals:
```
DR 2400 Deferred Revenue 12,500
CR 9999 Suspense Clearing 12,500
```
Reverse that suspense once approvals are in and post final JEs.
Ben (FP&A): I'll build the impact schedule (P&L by month + balance sheet movement) and circulate tomorrow AM. Routing to finance-approvals then.
revbot: Reminder: month-end cutoff 2024-07-31 17:00 UTC. Late JEs require full sign-off.
